parameters: ...Okay, I'm certain I haven't touched drink today but I think I'm hallucinatin' already!
Welcome back, Diana.\! How do you feel?
Grateful to be home...\! H-how long has it been?
Only a few moments for us.
By Donar's will, the boon of Galzus has come to Tahnra...\| I only hope I am a worthy steward of this gift.
Hell's bells. The Goddess of War just got even more... Goddessy.\! It just got reeeeeeal bad to be a bad guy.
